  • Class
    Description
    SpinApplication
     
    SpinConstructorDto
    Has only a constructor that takes all properties, without Jackson annotations.
    SpinDefaultConstructorDto
    Has a constructor without parameters and one that takes all properties, setters and fields with default values: the shape of Lombok's @Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor.
    SpinDefaultConstructorFinalFieldsDto
    What Kotlin compiles for a data class whose properties all have default values: final fields, getters, a constructor that takes all properties and checks them for null, and a constructor without parameters that uses the defaults.

    Has a constructor without parameters and one whose parameters come in another order than the fields.
    SpinRecordDto
    A record with an additional constructor without parameters: Spin reads it through the canonical constructor.
